obligations.note: The change sets payments PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and payments.privileged_idle_minutes to 16, which breaks the catalog bound payments.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15. No valid exception covers this deviation.

The cited EXC-0233 is scoped to component mortgage.session (Mortgage sessions), not payments.session, so it is out of scope. The only payments.session exception, EXC-0141, expired on 2026-09-09, before the review time of 2026-10-09.
Ticket CHG-25567 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-01 before review. Its components (payments.controls-data, payments.policy) cover both changed paths.
Sofia Santos has the change_approver role for payments and is not the author (Linh Nguyen). She gave a code_review approval on head commit 4312f88.
Both approvals name the single head commit 4312f88f2c24, and there are no later commits.

run.json claims a successful run on head by ci-runner-05. The only JUnit report, however, comes from hostname dev-laptop-7.local with timestamp 2026-10-23, after the review time, so it is not a valid report of this CI run. The registered SES-1 control test also 'passed' against a value of 16 that breaks the bound, which further undermines the evidence.
The change edits protected path controls/payments/policy-params.json. It has a control_owner approval on head from Rachel Stein (controls-office), who is outside the author's payments-eng team.
No ledger entry covers the changed code. The entries cover payments.py, audit.py, routes.py and mortgage files, and policy.py#PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES is not among them, so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1977 raises the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes, directly violating SES-1's 15-minute bound. The risk acceptance cited, EXC-0233, applies to mortgage.session, not payments, and the payments session exception EXC-0141 has expired, so EXC-1 is not met. The CI evidence is also unreliable: the JUnit report comes from a developer workstation and is dated after the review time. The change is rejected.
